tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la bstod pa tshigs bcad bcu gcig bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha brgya'i gtsug gis zhabs mchod cing*// kha ba'i dum 'khrugs 'khrigs pa'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i sku// bung ba'i phreng bas kun nas bsten pa'i padmo 'chang*// mchog sbyin dam pa 'gro ba'i re ba sgrub mdzad rgyal// spyan ras gzigs mgon rgyal sras thugs rje can// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// gang gi mtshan ni thugs rje che zhes bya// nyid kyi thugs rjes bdag la cis mi gzigs// khyod kyi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi mdzad na// skyabs mchog khyod la brten pa bdag /sdug bsngal gyur la mi gzigs sam// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i pha ma yang*// bu la byams pas skyong lags na// thugs rje mnga' ba 'gro ba'i yab// bdag cag ji ltar yal bar 'dor// lha yi dpag bsam shing lta bu// snying rje med kyang 'gro ba yi// 'dod pa'i bsam pa sgrub bgyid na// brtse ldan khyod kyis smos ci 'tshal// la la brtse yang thabs mi mkhas// la la thabs mkhas thugs rje med// thabs mkhas thugs rjer ldan pa khyod// phongs pa rnams la mi gzigs na// da ni mgon med rnams kyi skyabs// kye ma su zhig mdzad par 'gyur// tshe 'di skad cig re res 'dzad// lus kyang nyi ma re res rgas// gnyen rnams las kyis so sor 'bral// de bzhin phung po'ang so sor 'jig /'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang*// mar me snum zad ji bzhin du// ring por mi thogs nub par 'gyur// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i// sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher 'das// da ni thub pa'i dgongs min pa// chos ltar bcos pa du ma byung*// chos smra rnams la'ang ji ltar dgongs// bdag gis bgyi ba gang zhig lags// sems can rnams la ji ltar gzigs// thugs rje mnga' bas gsung du gsol// thugs rje chen po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// spyan ras gzigs la bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// thugs rje mnga' bas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig
/'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
